name: Requesty
short: OpenAI-compatible universal AI gateway and router connecting 600+ models with a default free tier for open-weights.

plans.name: Free Plan
plans.notes: Default plan on signup ($0/mo, no credit card required). Generates an OpenAI-compatible API key for local code with up to 200 requests/day (20 RPM) across select $0 models (Nemotron, Gemma, Mistral architectures).

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Unlocks 600+ models across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and open-source with 1,000+ RPD, semantic caching, and EU data residency.
